headline: Adopted decisions on 15 & 21 Fiske Avenue relief and a 337 River Street garage variance.
summary: Opportunities for Inclusion asked to keep an existing rear deck and consolidate prior relief at 15 & 21 Fiske Avenue (Case 2026-19). Abutters opposed the site plan, and a councilor said the petitioner agreed to keep a pergola and add plantings. The board also adopted findings and a decision for a two-vehicle garage variance at 337 River Street (Case 2026-20).
decisions: Adopted the proposed findings of fact for Case 2026-19, 15 & 21 Fiske Avenue, by a roll call vote of 5-0.
Adopted the proposed decisions for Case 2026-19, 15 & 21 Fiske Avenue, as amended, by a roll call vote of 5-0.
Adopted the proposed findings of fact for Case 2026-20, 337 River Street, by a roll call vote of 5-0.
Adopted the proposed decision as its decision for Case 2026-20, 337 River Street, by a roll call vote of 5-0; the chair then stated that it is granted.

Building Inspector G.L. c. 40A, §§ 8 and 15, alternatively relief under the Dover 
Amendment G.L, c. 40A, § 3. Subject Matter: The Petitioner requests to be able to continue 
to use and maintain the existing 15 Fiske Avenue structure (19.61 feet rear yard setback per 
Case No. 1998-06) and to continue to use and maintain the existing open deck to the rear of 
1
15 Fiske Avenue (4.9 feet rear yard setback per Case No. 2004-32). Further, to modify/

foot side yard setback variance for the open deck granted in Case No. 2004-32, to abandon 
the special permit granted for remote parking in Case No. 2004-32, and to reflect that said 
15 & 21 Fiske Avenue have now been combined into one lot. Location And Zoning District: 
15 & 21 Fiske Avenue; Residence A-4 Zoning District. Provisions Of Zoning Ordinance 
Involved: § 4.11, § 4.219, and§ 7.2. Specific Relief Sought: 
Primary Relief: Appeal from Decision of the Building Inspector G.L. c. 40A §§ 8 and 15: 
There are no proposed extensions or additions of the existing deck granted in Case No. 
2004-32 which is to remain for the continued use of the property, nor any changes to the 
existing structure, which would further reduce the rear yard setback relief granted in Case 
No. 1998-6. The subject matter of this case is to consolidate prior decisions in Case No. 
2004-32 and Case No. 1998-06 to allow continued use of the existing structure and deck 
triggered by the combination of 15 & 21 Fiske Avenue lots into one contiguous lot. 
Alternative Relief: Dover Amendment G.L. c. 40A, § 3: 
The Petitioner seeks relief under the Dover Amendment (G.L. c. 40A, § 3) to allow 
dimensional relief required to continue the use and maintenance of the existing structure 
with a rear yard setback of 19.61 feet per Case No. 1998-06 and an existing open deck to the 
rear of 15 Fiske Avenue with an approved rear yard setback of 4.9 feet as allowed in Case 
No. 2004-32 (surveyed 4.4 feet). As part of such relief, the Petitioner seeks to modify and/or 
consolidate the relief granted in said Case Nos. 2004-32 and 1998-06 to also abandon the 
side yard variance granted in Case No. 2004-32, to abandon the special permit granted for

remote parking in Case No. 2004-32, and to reflect that said 15 & 21 Fiske Avenue have 
now been combined into one lot. 
Rear Yard Setback: § 4.ll requires that rear yard setbacks in the Residence A-4 Zoning 
District shall be at least 30 feet. Here, the existing and proposed rear yard setback for the 
existing structure to remain is 19.61 feet as allowed in Case No. 1998-06. 
§ 4.11 and more specifically§ 4.219 requires as to unroofed porches "that at no point shall 
an actual

yard area setback be less than l;2 of the minimum yard area setback otherwise required for
